launches.title: ⭐ Voker - The Agent Analytics Platform
launches.tagline: Voker is analytics for the agentic era, so you can build the best agents possible.
launches.body:
### TL;DR: Voker is analytics for your conversational agent product, so you can build the best agents possible.  Our SDK transforms AI agent interactions into structured analytics dashboards that anyone on your team can use. Agent-first products like Lightfield use Voker to monitor and optimize their agents.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/7ff55d8b-ee06-4147-97c4-1236c50e0c5c)

## The Team 👬

\
[Tyler](https://www.linkedin.com/in/tyler-postle/) and [Alex](https://www.linkedin.com/in/alex-r-87470a198/) have been building Data and AI products and consulting for 9-figure businesses together since 2021. Tyler studied Physics at the College of Creative Studies @ UCSB, operated a $100M DTC e-commerce company, and was Director of Data at Appfolio (NASDAQ:APPF). Alex built AI infrastructure at multi-billion dollar companies and has a Masters in Computer Science.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/7d84f9c1-3d35-4e71-b359-162168ae0cae)

_Founders left to right: Tyler Postle (CEO), Alex Rudolph (CTO)_

## 🧨 The Problem: You have agents in production but you can’t keep track of quality and usage.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/6f2ad306-cb84-4b1d-9b7a-a8ae6ae9f054)

If you are building an agentic product with usage growing rapidly...

* Scanning traces doesn't tell you if agents are helpful, accurate, or hitting walls. You only find out when customers complain or attrition skyrockets.
* Every stakeholder needs data. Every request pulls engineers away from building. Nobody can self-serve insights.
* Product and business teams need to quantify the impact of their AI investments. You have usage stats, but your team is struggling to connect agent performance to conversion, retention, or revenue.

## 🎉 The Solution: Agent Analytics

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/8bbbfd52-25aa-43db-aab0-d75ac050a9a3)

Voker transforms user <> agent interactions into structured analytics that anyone on your team can use.

* PMs, analysts, and business teams get digestible insights they need without tickets, bottlenecks, or delays.
* Track what AI agents are saying, identify knowledge gaps, detect abnormalities, and measure improvement over time.
* Connect agent metrics to outcomes that matter by correlating conversational data with user data you’re already collecting.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/b9b51bc2-ecc3-46ba-8820-ec3e81d62db2)

**You shouldn’t have to wait for users to complain** to learn that a recent prompt change is breaking your hotel booking agent, or that the AI finance advisor you built is calling the wrong tool to look up realtime stock prices.

![uploaded image](/media/?type=post&id=83545&key=user_uploads/1924275/6a8cd7f8-6e16-4b63-a9a1-ab025f0b0f6e)

### Try for Free!

Install the [Voker SDK](https://app.voker.ai/docs) on our [free tier](https://voker.ai/#pricing) (up to 2,000 events/mo), and start building better agents today: <https://voker.ai/>
